allowlist.name: list_canon
allowlist.description: List files in the read-only canon mount

denied_examples.name: write_canon
denied_examples.why: write access to canon is never granted to the agent

denied_examples.name: http_fetch
denied_examples.why: no network: container runs with --network=none and no egress tool exists

denied_examples.name: exec_shell
denied_examples.why: no arbitrary command execution; only fixed argv for allowlisted tools

path_jail: reject ../ escapes and absolute paths outside
human: Only list_canon and read_canon can run.
Every path is jailed to /canon (mounted read-only).
Each allowed call runs in a fresh container: no network, read-only rootfs, all capabilities dropped, nobody user, 64 MB / 32 pids.
Blocked calls are never executed — their blast radius is zero.
